item.title: Tokachi Farm Stay Guide: Rural Life, Hot Springs & Access
item.description: The Tokachi plain in eastern Hokkaido is Japan’s breadbasket — an immense patchwork of farms beneath huge skies, centred on the city of Obihiro. Here you can swap the city for a farm stay, sleeping on a working dairy or crop farm, helping with chores, and feasting on just-picked produce, farm dairy and local beef. Tokachi is also home to the rare, amber “moor” hot springs (mojū-onsen) — peat-rich waters found in only a handful of places worldwide — and a famous food culture of sweets, cheese and the local “butadon” pork bowl.
